title: Health Safety
intro: Both travelers in excellent condition. September risks: Vietnam heat (28–32°C), monsoon food hygiene, mosquito-borne illness (dengue, Japanese encephalitis). Travel insurance with medical evacuation is non-negotiable for China.

bullets.heading: Travel Insurance (must-have)
items: Medical evacuation (China care for foreigners is complex/expensive)
Pre-existing conditions waiver; hiking + snorkeling coverage
World Nomads Explorer or Allianz OneTrip Prime
Purchase same day as first flight booking

bullets.heading: Prescriptions & First Aid
items: 14 days + 3-day buffer; doctor note in English; check controlled-substance import rules
Imodium + oral rehydration salts in carry-on
DEET 30%+ repellent; SPF 50 sunscreen; electrolyte tablets for Đà Nẵng heat
Motion sickness bands for Cham Islands boat

bullets.heading: Per-Country Health Notes
items: China: do NOT drink tap water; Sept AQI usually Moderate/Good—N95 if AQI >150; jet lag 12–13 hr from US East
Hanoi: bottled water only; DEET at dusk; dengue prevention only (no vaccine)
Đà Nẵng: Sept ~32°C, real-feel 37–40°C; 3+ L water/day; midday rest; SPF every 2 hrs at beach

callouts.text: Tea ceremony scam near Tiananmen/Wangfujing — polite decline (¥2,000+ bill)
Đà Nẵng heat: electrolytes, hydration, mandatory midday rest in September
Excellent physical condition — no mobility limits; adventure activities moderate-intensity only
